equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; age appears only in a background statement that all ages are affected. Residence-hall living and food handling are exposure settings, not social position.

ev.q: Persons of all ages are affected because previous infection confers only short-term immunity

notes: Structural record accepted. The Alaska food-specific analysis is cohort-like (attack rates among attendees) but is left under outbreak investigation; the Wisconsin food and event histories found no association and add no reported contrast.
